Overview.Name: Gandla Anusha
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Reducing autoimmune vasculitis-related inflammation, Preventing/reversing health issues, Improving recovery, Reducing headaches, Feeling energetic and confident
Overview.Preference_Notes: Vegetarian on Saturday, Sunday and Monday. Non-vegetarian on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.

Meal_1: Option 1: Slow cooked bone broth (250 ml) + 1 boiled egg
Option 2: Cooked white rice (150 g) + curd (200 g)
Option 3: Grilled chicken (100 g) + any 1 fruit
Meal_2: Option 1: Grilled meat (150 g chicken, fish or mutton)
Option 2: Paneer (100 g) + cooked rice (150 g)
Meal_3: Option 1: Grilled chicken (150 g) or fish (150 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Use only homemade ghee, butter or coconut oil for cooking.
Avoid all seed oils including sunflower oil, rice bran oil, soybean oil, cottonseed oil, mustard oil and blended vegetable oils.
Avoid sugar completely. If cravings occur, have fruit instead.
Avoid pulses, dals, legumes and nuts.
Drink coconut water daily to support hydration and help reduce headaches.
Get at least 30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Aim to sleep around 9 PM and wake naturally whenever possible.
Avoid screens for 1 hour before bedtime and use that time for reading or relaxation.
Maintain at least a 3-hour gap between your last meal and sleep.
Keep cooking simple with minimal spices and masala.
Follow vegetarian options on Saturday, Sunday and Monday.
Bone broth, eggs, fish and quality protein sources can support recovery and overall health.
